hook: A creator chained five different AI tools into one pipeline to kill motion design's biggest time sink.
caption:
5 AI tools, one pipeline, a finished motion piece — zero manual keyframing 🤯

Motion design usually means hours of hand-placed keyframes. This creator skipped all of it.

→ Claude Opus 5.5 wrote and ran the script
→ Higgsfield built the 3D scenes and camera moves
→ After Effects handled the animation and compositing
→ Suno scored the music, Soundly added the sound effects

Would you swap your motion design workflow for a pipeline like this? 👇
